# Artefact index

<!-- Generated by `methodology.py index` from `artefacts:` in rpa-methodology.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Which documents the skill produces, which of them every project needs, who reads them, and in which languages
they can be rendered. Core documents are needed by every project; extended documents are added when the project
needs them. The tier and the audience are a proposal until the owner of the skill confirms them.

## Core

- **PDD** (`pdd`)
  - Audience: Business (Process owner, the clerks who do the work, business analyst); Approver (Process owner sign-off, Works Council (Betriebsrat), data protection officer)
  - Languages: en, de
  - Files: `*pdd*.md`; client-facing, version history and approvals
- **SDD** (`sdd`)
  - Audience: Technical (Solution architect, developers, operations and security)
  - Languages: en, de
  - Files: `*sdd*.md`; client-facing, version history and approvals

  - Files: `*arch*.md`

  - Files: `*estimation*.md`; client-facing, version history and approvals
